niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel complete, structured, and information-rich, with clear sectioning and strong hierarchy, but without looking heavy or cluttered. They like light, airy, polished layouts with compact spacing, subtle dividers, and readable row-based organization. They also favor clear labels, obvious actions, and enough contextual detail to feel trustworthy and finished. In contrast, they reject sparse, empty, overly promotional, or overly busy screens.

criteria.description: Fully populated screens with many visible items, settings, or contact entries rather than sparse or empty layouts.
Multiple clearly separated sections or grouped panels that make the page feel structured and easy to scan.
Even distribution of content across the screen, avoiding top-heavy layouts and large unused blank areas.
Tighter, more efficient vertical spacing that keeps the interface feeling full and efficient without wasted space.
Specific, descriptive labels and titles that make settings and actions immediately understandable.
Consistent row-based lists with clear dividers, chevrons, and predictable drill-in or toggle behavior.
Clear title prominence and section hierarchy that helps the user quickly understand what matters most.
Light, airy, refined interfaces with softer contrast, subtle borders, and a clean app-like finish.
Obvious primary actions, clear disabled states, and explicit feedback about what the user can do next.
